routes.description: Click at a point, or on a drawn label by its text, on the active mouse handler, then wait for the click to be drawn.

params.name: label
params.help: Click the one visible clickable drawn label with this text instead of x/y; refuses, listing candidates, when absent, out of view or ambiguous.

params.name: within
params.help: Only labels drawn in this view id, as words lists them.

params.name: index
params.help: Which of several visible clickable label matches, in drawing order.

params.name: x
params.help: Target X coordinate.

params.name: y
params.help: Target Y coordinate.

params.name: normalized
params.help: Treat X/Y as fractions of window size rather than pixels.

params.name: button
params.help: GLFW mouse button code.

params.name: count
params.help: Press/release pairs delivered back to back; 2 is a double-click.

params.name: mods
params.help: Modifier keys held down for the click and released after, +-separated: shift, ctrl, alt.

params.name: settle
params.help: Frames to wait for after the click, so a screenshot needs no sleep; 0 returns at once.

routes.responseHint: {ok, settled, event:{xPx, yPx, xNorm, yNorm, button, mods, label?, view?}, activeTool, previousTool?, control (the controls-menu row clicked, else null), tool?:{name, lastRow, error, undo/redo heads, mode?}}, or {ok:false, error, candidates} when a label refuses

routes.description: Fire a control row by its action id, a tool's, active or not, or the scene's own, switching to the tool first as its switch key would, and report the outcome as key and click do.

params.name: tool
params.help: Tool name as the tools listing gives it; the active tool when left out.

params.name: action
params.help: The row's action id exactly as the tools listing gives it.

params.name: key
params.help: The row's key label instead of its action id, ignoring case.

params.name: settle
params.help: Frames to wait for after the row fired; 0 returns at once.

routes.responseHint: {ok, action, key, control, settled, activeTool, previousTool?, tool:{name, lastRow, error, undo heads, mode?}}, or {ok:false, error, candidates}

routes.description: Drag with the left button from one window point to another, a frame drawn after every step.

params.name: fromX
params.help: Start X in window pixels.

params.name: fromY
params.help: Start Y in window pixels.

params.name: toX
params.help: End X in window pixels.

params.name: toY
params.help: End Y in window pixels.

params.name: steps
params.help: Equal moves the drag is split into.

params.name: hold
params.help: Frames drawn with the button held still at the end before the release.

params.name: settle
params.help: Frames to wait for after the release.

routes.responseHint: {ok, steps, settled}

routes.description: Fit the camera to a selection, a region, a ring, a point and radius or an explicit box, filling the view with it.

params.name: selection
params.help: What to frame: mesh, overlay, tag:NAME, edge-mark:LABEL, ring:LABEL, region:N[,M] or region:selected, or a bare name.

params.name: bounds
params.help: Explicit box as minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ; overrides every other selection.

params.name: point
params.help: A point x,y,z to frame with --radius around it.

params.name: radius
params.help: Radius of the sphere framed around --point.

params.name: region
params.help: Ring regions by the numbers in the region tool's item labels, comma-separated, or 'selected' for the region tool's selection.

params.name: ring
params.help: A ring by its label in the ring-tool scene: a graph ring or 'ring #N'.

params.name: padding
params.help: Margin around the selection as a fraction of its radius.

params.name: azimuth
params.help: Orbit azimuth in radians to view from; omitted keeps the current angle.

params.name: elevation
params.help: Orbit elevation in radians to view from, +-1.5708 for a true top or bottom view; omitted keeps the current angle.

routes.responseHint: {ok, selection, matchedVertices, boundsMin, boundsMax, center, radius, padding, azimuth, elevation, distance, requestedDistance, error?}

routes.description: Liveness probe reporting server status, recording/replaying flags, and port.

routes.description: Move the cursor without clicking, then wait for the hover to be drawn.

params.name: x
params.help: Target X coordinate.

params.name: y
params.help: Target Y coordinate.

params.name: normalized
params.help: Treat X/Y as fractions of window size rather than pixels.

params.name: persistent
params.help: Hold the hover lock so real mouse motion cannot dislodge it; false clears it.

params.name: settle

routes.description: Release the persistent automation hover lock on the active mouse handler.

routes.description: Deliver a named key event to the active key handler and report what took it: the control row it fired, or that nothing did, and the active tool's state after.
